# gyro_storage_bucket_notification (Resource)

Bucket event notification (webhook) of Gyro Object Storage / Protected Storage: a signed HTTPS POST is sent to `url` when an object is created, deleted, or a bulk delete runs. Signature: X-Gyro-Signature = sha256=HMAC-SHA256(secret, X-Gyro-Timestamp + "." + raw body). Delivery is at least once (retried up to 8 times, about 2 hours); 20 failures in a row disable the webhook (status disabled, disabled_reason auto_failures; apply again with enabled = true to re-enable). Monthly free allowance per bucket plus prepaid event packs, no overage invoice.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Image uploads to "resimler/" trigger your thumbnail service.
resource "gyro_storage_bucket_notification" "thumbnails" {
  service_id  = 456
  bucket      = gyro_storage_bucket.assets.name
  url         = "https://ornek.com/s3-olay"
  events      = ["storage.object.created"]
  prefix      = "resimler/"
  suffix      = [".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp"]
  description = "Gyro Proje küçük resim"
}

# Verify X-Gyro-Signature in your application with this value (sha256=HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + "." + raw body)).
output "event_secret" {
  value     = gyro_storage_bucket_notification.thumbnails.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) Bucket name.
- `service_id` (Number) Object / Protected Storage service id.
- `url` (String) Target address: https only, port 443 or 8443, on the public internet.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free text (at most 128 characters).
- `enabled` (Boolean) false = paused (no events are sent).
- `events` (List of String) storage.object.created, storage.object.deleted, storage.objects.deleted_bulk (default: all three).
- `prefix` (String) Only keys starting with this text.
- `suffix` (List of String) Only keys ending with one of these (case-insensitive, at most 10), e.g. [".jpg", ".png"].

### Read-Only

- `disabled_reason` (String) user, auto_failures or empty.
- `id` (String) <service_id>/<webhook_id>
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Signing secret (returned only when created; empty after import - rotate it with the API / CLI if needed).
- `status` (String) active or disabled.
- `webhook_id` (Number) Webhook id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <service_id>/<webhook_id>  (the secret cannot be read back; rotate it with: gyro storage events rotate-secret <service_id> <webhook_id>)
terraform import gyro_storage_bucket_notification.thumbnails 456/7
```
